description: Inventory tracking system for the host - add quantity column to menu_items, create inventory management page, auto-decrement stock when fulfilling requests, show low-stock alerts.
steps: Add a `quantity` integer column (nullable, null means unlimited/not tracked) to the `menuItems` table in src/lib/schema.ts. Add a `lowStockThreshold` integer column (default 3) to support configurable low-stock alerts per item.
Create a new SQL migration file at migrations/0002_inventory.sql that adds the `quantity` and `low_stock_threshold` columns to the `menu_items` table using ALTER TABLE.
Update src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/menu/route.ts POST endpoint to accept an optional `quantity` field when adding menu items.
Update src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/menu/[itemId]/route.ts PATCH endpoint to accept `quantity` and `lowStockThreshold` fields for updating inventory.

Create a new API route at src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/inventory/route.ts that returns all menu items with their current quantities, grouped by category, including a computed `isLowStock` boolean (quantity <= lowStockThreshold and quantity is not null).

Modify the request fulfillment logic in src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/requests/[requestId]/route.ts: when a DRINK or SUPPLY request status transitions to DONE, auto-decrement the matching menu item's quantity by 1 (only if quantity is not null and > 0). If quantity hits 0, auto-set available to false. Publish an SSE 'inventory-update' event.

Create a new host component at src/components/host/InventoryManager.tsx that displays all menu items with their quantities, allows the host to set/edit initial quantities (e.g. '12 Modelos'), shows low-stock alerts (yellow warning for items at or below threshold), and out-of-stock indicators. Use ARIA roles for accessibility. Subscribe to 'inventory-update' SSE events for live updates.
Add an 'Inventory' tab to the host dashboard in src/app/host/[hostCode]/page.tsx that renders the InventoryManager component.

Ensure the guest-facing API at src/app/api/party/[guestCode]/route.ts still only returns available items (existing behavior is correct, but items that hit quantity 0 now become unavailable automatically).
acceptance_criteria: Host can set initial quantities for drinks and supplies from the inventory tab
When a request is marked DONE for a tracked item, its quantity decrements by 1
Items that reach quantity 0 are automatically marked as unavailable
Low-stock items (at or below threshold) show a visual warning on the inventory page
Inventory changes are pushed to connected hosts via SSE in real-time
The migration SQL file is syntactically correct ALTER TABLE statements
verification: Run npm run build and confirm it succeeds with no TypeScript errors
Run npm test and confirm all tests pass
findings: Build and tests pass. The guest-facing API at /api/party/[guestCode] already filters by available=true so auto-disabling items at quantity 0 works seamlessly. The menu POST route was also updated to accept category in the body (previously hardcoded to DRINK). The inventory-update SSE event is published with computed isLowStock and isOutOfStock fields.
